mainEntity.name: How much does Generative Engine Optimization cost for a home service company?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of Generative Engine Optimization for a home service company varies based on several factors, including the scope of services needed, the competitiveness of your local market (e.g., Houston vs. a smaller city), the size of your business, and your specific goals. A custom proposal is developed after an initial consultation and audit. Generally, pricing can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month, reflecting the specialized AI tools, content generation, and ongoing optimization efforts required. We focus on delivering a strong return on investment through increased lead generation and bookings.
